event_templates.name: Walk Aimlessly 1
event_texts: You walk around aimlessly while the world is being tested.

event_templates.name: Talk 1
event_texts: You talk with <<char1.short_desc>>.
<<char0.Short_desc>> talks with you.

event_templates.name: Talk 2
event_texts: You are in a conversation with <<char1.short_desc>> and laugh at <<char1.his>> joke.
You tell a joke to <<char0.short_desc>> and <<he>> laughs at it.

event_templates.name: Overhear 1
event_texts: You walk past two people talking. The <<char1.short_desc>> tells the <<char2.short_desc>> about what <<he>> did yesterday.
You talk to <<char2.short_desc>> about what you did yesterday and notice <<char0.short_desc>> walk by.
<<char1.Short_desc>> tells you about what <<he>> did yesterday while <<char0.short_desc>> listens in.

event_templates.name: Overhear 2
event_texts: You overhear an argument at the village square. Two villagers are shouting over a stolen chicken. You consider whether to intervene or keep walking.
You see <<char2.short_desc>> walking away from your yard with a chicken you recently purchased. "That was my chicken!" you yell, your voice cracking as frustration grows.

While walking down the path you see a nearby fenced in yard with a chicken you lost a few days ago. You hop the fence to take it back when <<char1.short_desc>> approaches you and starts yelling at you that you are stealing <<char1.his>> chicken. "You’re lying! I raised that chicken from a chick!" you retort, unwilling to let this matter slide.

event_templates.name: Foraging 1
event_texts: You run low on supplies so you walk to the forest and start foraging for food.

event_templates.name: Foraging 2
event_texts: While foraging for food you find plenty for berries and fruit.

event_templates.name: Foraging 3
event_texts: Part way through your foraging expedition you run into a hunter who shares some of <<char1.his>> bounty with you.
While hunting you run into <<char0.short_desc>> and share some of your bounty with <<char0.him>>.

event_templates.name: Hunting 1
event_texts: You decide to go out hunting.

event_templates.name: Hunting 2
event_texts: On your hunting trip you kill a boar

event_templates.name: Hunting 3
event_texts: You find an kill a deer.

event_templates.name: Snack 1
event_texts: You decide to eat a snack.

event_templates.name: Snack 2
event_texts: You eat a meal.

event_templates.name: Rest 1
event_texts: You lay down for a while.

event_templates.name: Rest 2
event_texts: You lay down to sleep.

event_templates.name: Rest 3
event_texts: You dream of electric sheep.

event_templates.name: Weird 1
event_texts: You walk along a pathway and find a <<char1.short_desc>> sleeping in a bush.
You dream about chocolate clouds.

event_templates.name: Weird 2
event_texts: A violent storm batters the village. You huddle inside, listening to the wind howl, hoping your roof holds through the night.

event_templates.name: Weird 3
event_texts: As the storm rages, you check your shutters. The wind is fierce tonight, and you wonder if your neighbor is faring as well.

event_templates.name: Market 1
event_texts: You arrive at the village market just as the sun rises, the smell of fresh bread and herbs filling the air. You decide to purchase some wheat flour for the week ahead.

event_templates.name: Market 2
event_texts: In the alley behind the market, <<char1.short_desc>> offers you a rare herb. The price is steep, but it could be valuable for your garden.
You spot <<char0.short_desc>> who’s been eyeing you. It’s time to try to sell some rare herbs you found.

event_templates.name: Market 3
event_texts: A mysterious traveler arrives in the village, selling strange items from distant lands. You are tempted to buy a small amulet said to bring good fortune.
You make your way through the village, offering trinkets and baubles to the curious villagers. <<char0.short_desc>> seems particularly interested in your wares.

event_templates.name: Chores 1
event_texts: Your fence is broken, and you spend the afternoon patching it. It's tiring work, but at least your livestock won't wander off now
You watch from the other side of your field as your neighbor struggles to mend their fence. You wonder if you should offer help or stay focused on your own chores.

event_templates.name: Chores 2
event_texts: The village elder has asked for help in the fields. You grab your hoe and head out, ready for a hard day's work.

event_templates.name: Chores 4
event_texts: You survey the group of villagers who have come to help. Among them, you see the young one who is always willing to lend a hand.

event_templates.name: Chores 5
event_texts: You bring sacks of grain to the village mill, waiting as the giant stone wheels grind them into flour. The miller leans against the wall with <<his>> head hanging low. <<He>> looks tired, as usual.
Another villager arrives with grain. You smile, but your hands are sore from the long hours, and you silently hope for a day off.

event_templates.name: Fun 1
event_texts: The village is alive with music and celebration. You find yourself swept into a dance with the others, the flicker of bonfires lighting the night. Your eyes meet those of <<char1.short_desc>> as <<he>> smiles at you as you begin to dance together.
You twirl through the crowd, linking arms with the villagers. Among them, <<char0.short_desc>> seems a little hesitant but soon falls into the rhythm of the dance.

event_templates.name: Bad 1
event_texts: Late at night, you overhear a conversation between two villagers plotting something in secret. <<char1.Short_desc>> is waving <<his>> hands frantically. You can’t make out all the words, but <<his>> tone is ominous.

You sneak out to meet a friend of yours who agreed to help you steal back some farming equipment you are sure was stolen from you. As you explain the plan to <<him>>, <<he>> shows uncertainty in the plan and asks if you think it will work. "It has to. There’s no other way," you reply, determined to see the plan through.

You meet up with a friend of yours late at night like they asked in a note they sent to you. <<He>> explains how some farming equipment was stolen from <<him>> and <<he>> wants your help to get it back. You'd rather not do this as getting caught could lead to your reputation in the village being tarnished. You ask <<him>> in a hushed voice, "Are you sure this will work?"
